description: This Java class, DefaultPersistenceCleanupConfig, provides configuration handling for persistence cleanup in the Eclipse Ditto services. It reads configuration parameters such as enablement, timing durations, and retention counts, encapsulates them, and offers accessors for use elsewhere in the application.

classes.name: DefaultPersistenceCleanupConfig
classes.description: Implementation of the PersistenceCleanupConfig interface providing configuration details for persistence cleanup processes.

methods.description: Factory method to create a PersistenceCleanupConfig instance with service-specific configuration, applying fallback logic.
